### 'Til the Last Drop
Author: Elizabeth Cole
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/til-the-last-drop-homeword-october-3.html
Passage: Mark 14:6, 8a
Points:
- Scent carries powerful memories, much like the enduring fragrance of Mary's sacrificial devotion in Bethany.
- Mary acted decisively, giving her best without being deterred by the murmuring and judgment of onlookers.
- Jesus recognized the posture of her heart and vindicated her costly offering.
- Believers are called to imitate her example by dedicating their all to Christ as a pleasing aroma.

### Day 148: Luke 7:39–48
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-148-luke-7-3948.html
Passage: Luke 7:39-48
Points:
- Jesus exposes hidden critical thoughts and holds people accountable for the judgmental things said to themselves.
- Simon defined his righteousness by what he avoided, failing to offer Jesus basic hospitality and grace.
- Through the parable of the two debtors, Christ shows that a profound awareness of forgiveness ignites profuse love.
- Jesus never minimizes sin, but his complete forgiveness liberates people to love God wholeheartedly.

### He Welcomed Her Worship
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/he-welcomed-her-worship
Passage: Mark 14:3-9
Points:
- True worshipers of Jesus often appear undignified, reckless, or disruptive to a lukewarm world.
- Critical onlookers calculate the temporal cost and condemn radical sacrifices for Christ as wasteful.
- Extravagant devotion exposes and threatens those who prefer to keep their religion measured and safe.
- Jesus vindicates the woman because he cherishes any offering made in response to his worth.
- Her shattered jar foreshadows Christ pouring out his own blood and life for his people.

### Anointed for Burial
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/anointed-burial
Passage: Matthew 26:6-13
Points:
- Mary poured out an entire year's wages worth of oil, showing total dedication to honoring Jesus.
- The disciples failed to grasp proper priorities, as loving Christ directly took precedence during his final earthly days.
- Jesus interpreted her act of devotion as a prophetic preparation for his approaching death and burial.
- While Christ's glory is central, God graciously honors and remembers those who faithfully serve him.
